criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?
DCE handling writes/reads the id as big-endian across bytes 0-3 and stores the domain in byte 9, and Domain()/ID() decode those same offsets.
Binary unmarshaling rejects any input not exactly 16 bytes with an error instead of silently truncating or accepting.

Hash-based generation resets the hash, writes namespace then data, copies the first 16 sum bytes, and sets the version/variant nibbles — deriving the result from the actual namespace and data rather than canned values.
